evals.name: generic-hero-diagnosis-first
evals.prompt: My coaching site hero feels generic. Headline: 'Welcome to my website'. Centered stock photo, a small grey 'Learn more' link. Make it better.
evals.expected_output: Starts with step 1 diagnosis (weak, working, preserve, change) before rewriting or redesigning, asks for a screenshot at desktop and mobile if none.

assertions.text: starts with a diagnosis of what is weak, what works and what to keep
names the vague headline and the low-visibility CTA as problems
asks for or uses a rendered screenshot at desktop and mobile widths
does not jump straight to new code or a new palette

evals.name: headline-only
evals.prompt: Just rewrite my hero headline. I'm a grief counselor for parents; current headline: 'Helping you heal'.
evals.expected_output: Jumps to Message Hierarchy: specific headline options naming the audience and outcome, one emphasised word.

assertions.text: goes directly to the message hierarchy step without a full diagnosis
offers headlines that name the audience (grieving parents) and an outcome
does not invent testimonials or credentials

evals.name: keep-design-system
evals.prompt: Redesign my hero. We use Tailwind with our own brand tokens and shadcn; screenshot attached.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the existing tokens and components, changes hierarchy and composition only.

assertions.text: states it will keep the project's existing fonts, colours and components
does not propose a new colour palette
